The issuer shows very weak balance-sheet credit fundamentals: shareholders’ equity is negative (−2,646M) with liabilities exceeding assets (total liabilities 37,604M vs. total assets 35,008M), indicating material leverage and balance-sheet stress. Liquidity is also weak (current ratio 0.62). While operating profitability appears positive (EBIT/operating income 3,230M), the negative equity and leverage offset that, leading to a speculative-grade rating.
